Package simulation

Class BinaryHeap<E>

java.lang.Object
simulation.BinaryHeap<E>
Type Parameters:
E - the type of elements in this queue
All Implemented Interfaces:
Iterable<E>, Collection<E>, AdjustablePriorityQueue<E>
public class BinaryHeap<E> extends Object implements AdjustablePriorityQueue<E>
A binary heap implementation of AdjustablePriorityQueue. This implementation maintains a min-heap structure along with a HashMap for efficient lookups. The time complexities are: - insert: O(log n) - extractMin: O(log n) - peekMin: O(1) - updatePriority: O(log n) - getPriority: O(1) - contains: O(1) - size: O(1) - clear: O(n)
